title: Quality of Raw Water for Singapore’s Water Treatment Plants in Johor
what_it_is: Quality of Raw Water for Singapore’s Water Treatment Plants in Johor

sections.label: Johor River pollution shutdowns
sections.summary: PUB shuts down its Johor River Waterworks when the Johor River is polluted upstream, with seven such incidents since 2017 traced to illegal discharges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Public Utilities Board (PUB) will shut down its Johor River Waterworks when the Johor River is affected by pollution upstream of our waterworks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since 2017, there have been seven pollution incidents along the Johor River which caused PUB's Johor River Waterworks to be temporarily shut down.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These incidents have been traced to illegal discharges from premises, such as palm oil mills and chicken farms within the catchment area.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These pollution incidents typically cause disruptions ranging from several hours to several days.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: So far this year, there have been two pollution incidents, with the most recent one on 4 April 2019, where there were high ammonia levels in the Johor River.

sections.label: 1962 Water Agreement entitlements
sections.summary: Under the 1962 Water Agreement Singapore may draw 250 mgd from the Johor River and Johor may buy up to 2% of imported water.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Under the 1962 Water Agreement, Singapore is entitled to draw 250 million gallons per day (mgd) of water from the Johor River, while Johor is entitled to buy treated water up to 2% of the total quantity of water we import to Singapore on any given day, or about five mgd, when Singapore draws its full entitlement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In practice, we have been selling Johor 16 mgd of treated water, which is in excess of their entitlement, at Johor's request.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: When we are unable to import any water from Johor due to pollution, Singapore has no obligation to supply treated water to Malaysia.

sections.label: PUB steps up production
sections.summary: During temporary disruptions, PUB steps up production at desalination plants and local waterworks to meet Singapore's demand.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: During such temporary disruptions, PUB steps up production at desalination plants and local waterworks to meet Singapore's demand.
